_about: The repository controls every security provider checks (contract/security/v1/protocol.md), each a row with `subject: repository` in every `check` result. A provider adds its own controls, under either subject; a repository adds its own in `.agent-rfc/security/control_registry.json`.

controls.title: Risk register
controls.passes: it matches risk_register.schema.json and holds no template entry (an id starting RISK-EXAMPLE-)

controls.title: Agency manifest
controls.passes: it matches agency_manifest.schema.json, holds no shipped placeholder, and at least one action needs a human

controls.title: Tool allowlist
controls.passes: the allowlist exists and every registered tool resolves the way it says, with the deny path exercised

controls.title: Prompt-injection guard enforces
controls.passes: the declared mode enforces — default or strict; undeclared is default. Never the environment

controls.title: Input guardrail scrubs
controls.passes: the declared mode is not off; undeclared scrubs outside development

controls.title: Output moderation declared
controls.passes: moderation.mode is declared; under required, moderation.hook names a module.path:callable that imports in the repository's interpreter and answers benign text with allowed: true

controls.title: Telemetry redacted on the wire
controls.passes: redaction passes for staging and production; not applicable when the emitter is declared none

controls.title: Changes governed by a gate
controls.passes: a gate provider is declared, not none

controls.title: Golden eval gradable
controls.passes: it is gradable under contract/evals/v1 (at least 3 cases, each with its output); not applicable with no dataset; a gap when providers.json evals.not_gradable declares golden a warning

controls.title: Fairness eval gradable
controls.passes: as SEC-EVAL-001, for fairness (at least 2 cases)

controls.title: Adversarial probes
controls.passes: the adversarial suite passes under contract/evals/v1; not applicable with no dataset

controls.title: RAG poisoning probes
controls.passes: the rag_poison suite passes under contract/evals/v1; not applicable with no dataset
